configurationRuleEvidence.finding: Template disadvantages apply in combat against modern ships, not against another archaic ship.
CL 2/3 normal; half damage threshold against modern weapons; 50% shield failure when SR exceeded; archaic weapons cannot critically hit nonarchaic ships; -2 attacks against modern ships.

Upgrade to remove archaic disadvantages takes 1 week of work multiplied by ship cost modifier, and credits equal 1/10 the original ship cost. DC25 Mechanics per week; a failed check loses that week. Multiple workers divide total time by number of successful checks (printed rules).
Illustrative Archaic template applied to a Dreadnaught, not an independent new ordinary Dreadnaught model.

configurationRuleEvidence.finding: Organic gravity field SR25 is not a shield generator; any single damaging shot leaves SR unchanged, even exceeding SR; does not decrement 5 as conventional shields.

Swift action choose one benefit: +2 squares starship speed OR +5 own SR OR +1 weapon damage die for dovin basal; mutually exclusive that use.

Ships fail to receive their own ship Intelligence bonus to attack coralskippers until computer recognizes target by 1 minute of reprogramming and DC15 Use Computer; do not treat as all attack bonuses being suppressed.
